items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Duke or Sunny, if they hadn't worked up an act for Ivy... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, she had a lot of personality.

ctx.x: Or sensational. But he was a good singer. But I mean if Ivy hadn't -- if they hadn't, Duke or Sunny, if they hadn't worked up an act for Ivy, she'd have never gone over so big. To my way of thinking. What do you think?
Well, she had a lot of personality.
